limitations_and_boundaries: The study primarily uses in vitro assays and xenograft models; clinical relevance in human tumors is not directly tested.
The role of other JAK family members or STATs beyond JAK1 and STAT3 is not exhaustively examined.
The feedback loop between contractility and STAT3 is demonstrated but the detailed molecular mechanism is not fully elucidated.
The effects of cytokine signaling on other modes of migration (e.g., mesenchymal) are not addressed.
The study focuses on squamous cell carcinoma and melanoma; generalizability to other cancer types is unknown.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.
